_comment: Generated by tools/style-tags/export.js from the classified style briefs. Do not hand-edit; see docs/style-taxonomy.md.

white.label: White gambit
white.glossary: White gives up material, usually a pawn, for time, development or attack.

black.label: Black gambit
black.glossary: Black gives up material, usually a pawn, for time, development or attack.

solid.label: Solid
solid.glossary: Hard to break down, with few ways to lose quickly. Play is steady, not forcing.

sharp.label: Sharp
sharp.glossary: Concrete, forcing play where both sides take risks. One wrong move can lose fast.

dubious.label: Dubious
dubious.glossary: Strong players consider it unsound. It scores through surprise and traps.

open.label: Open
open.glossary: Central pawns come off early, leaving open files and diagonals for the pieces.

semi_open.label: Semi-open
semi_open.glossary: The centre is partly open. Usually one side gets a half-open file to press on.

closed.label: Closed
closed.glossary: The central pawns lock together, and play moves to the wings.

system.label: System
system.glossary: A set-up you can play against almost anything. Plans matter more than move orders.

offbeat.label: Offbeat
offbeat.glossary: Seldom played by strong players. Chosen mainly for surprise.

beginner.label: Beginner
beginner.glossary: Clear plans and little to memorise. A good first repertoire choice.

advanced.label: Advanced
advanced.glossary: Either long forcing lines you need to know, or plans that are hard to get right.

isolated_queens_pawn.label: Isolated queen's pawn
isolated_queens_pawn.glossary: A lone d-pawn. It gives active pieces now and is a target later.

hanging_pawns.label: Hanging pawns
hanging_pawns.glossary: Two centre pawns side by side with no neighbours. Strong when they advance, weak when they stall.

carlsbad_structure.label: Carlsbad structure
carlsbad_structure.glossary: The Queen's Gambit Exchange pawn shape, home of the minority attack.

maroczy_bind.label: Maróczy Bind
maroczy_bind.glossary: White pawns on c4 and e4 clamp down on d5.

hedgehog.label: Hedgehog
hedgehog.glossary: Pawns kept on the sixth rank, waiting to break out with …b5 or …d5.

stonewall.label: Stonewall
stonewall.glossary: Pawns on c3, d4, e3 and f4 (or Black's mirror), with an eye on e5 and the kingside.

doubled_pawns.label: Doubled pawns
doubled_pawns.glossary: One side accepts doubled pawns for the bishop pair or open lines.

fianchetto.label: Fianchetto
fianchetto.glossary: A bishop on g2, g7, b2 or b7, aimed down the long diagonal.

space_advantage.label: Space advantage
space_advantage.glossary: One side gains space and the other has to find room for its pieces.

central_pawn_majority.label: Central pawn majority
central_pawn_majority.glossary: More pawns in the centre, to be pushed later.

half_open_c_file.label: Half-open c-file
half_open_c_file.glossary: A rook on the c-file presses with no pawn of its own in the way.

knight_outpost.label: Knight outpost
knight_outpost.glossary: A knight on a square no pawn can chase it from, such as d5 or e5.

bishop_pair.label: Bishop pair
bishop_pair.glossary: Two bishops against bishop and knight, an edge once the position opens.

bad_bishop.label: Bad bishop
bad_bishop.glossary: A bishop hemmed in by its own pawns, a long-term problem.

kingside_attack.label: Kingside attack
kingside_attack.glossary: Pieces and pawns aimed at the king.

pawn_storm.label: Pawn storm
pawn_storm.glossary: Pawns marched up the board at the enemy king.

opposite_side_castling.label: Opposite-side castling
opposite_side_castling.glossary: Kings on opposite wings and a race to attack first.

minority_attack.label: Minority attack
minority_attack.glossary: Two queenside pawns advanced against three, to leave a weakness behind.

queenside_expansion.label: Queenside expansion
queenside_expansion.glossary: Pawns pushed on the queenside to gain space and open lines there.

pressure_on_f7.label: Pressure on f7
pressure_on_f7.glossary: Pieces aimed at f7, the weak point beside Black's king early on.

lead_in_development.label: Lead in development
lead_in_development.glossary: Pieces out faster, often for a pawn, and the need to use them quickly.

hypermodern_centre.label: Hypermodern centre
hypermodern_centre.glossary: Let the opponent build a centre, then attack it with pieces and pawn breaks.

early_queen.label: Early queen
early_queen.glossary: The queen comes out early and has to dodge the attacks on her.

symmetrical_structure.label: Symmetrical structure
symmetrical_structure.glossary: Mirror-image pawns and a slow fight for small edges.
